promises.quote: PFD action plan was reviewed at Clinical Governance meetings on 22 March 2024. It is listed to be an agenda item every month until September 2024 and provided that all actions are embedded at that point, it will be closed.
promises.summary: Reviewed action plan at Clinical Governance meetings

promises.quote: The action plan has been shared with the Senior Management Team for, and the Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT) and all staff involved in Mr [name redacted] care at, Cygnet Hospital Derby.
promises.summary: Shared action plan with Senior Management Team and MDT

promises.quote: The action plan is included in Cygnet Derby Overarching Local Action Plan (OLAP) and reviewed bi-monthly by the General Manager, Hospital Manager, and Clinical Manager to ensure completion and embedding of the actions.
promises.summary: Included action plan in OLAP and reviewed bi-monthly

promises.quote: The action plan was discussed and agreed at Medical Advisory Committee (MAC) (8 March 2024).
promises.summary: Discussed and agreed action plan at MAC

promises.quote: The action plan will also be disseminated to NHS IMPACT Contract meeting for Commissioner scrutiny and openness of process (23 May 2024).
promises.summary: Disseminate action plan to NHS IMPACT Contract meeting

promises.quote: The manipulation measurement tool, currently used for females, to be added as an addendum to the HCR-20 (a Secure Services Standard Risk Assessment tool for baseline risk assessment) and used for males going forward.
promises.summary: Add manipulation measurement tool to HCR-20 for males
